```{R}
library(gplots)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(UpSetR)
```

```{R}
human_results = read_xlsx("ext/Record Reviews/three_literature_search_humans.xlsx", skip=1)
names(human_results)[16:19] = c("lehallierCite_khs",
                                "methodology_khs",
                                "ageTopic_khs",
                                "notes_khs")
names(human_results)[20:23] = c("lehallierCite_mc",
                                "methodology_mc",
                                "ageTopic_mc",
                                "notes_mc")
```

Read Claude results:

```{R}
claude_results = read_xlsx("../ext/Record Reviews/three_literature_search_shared_for_Claude_classified.xlsx", skip=1)
names(claude_results)[16:19] = c("lehallierCite_claude",
                                "methodology_claude",
                                "ageTopic_claude",
                                "notes_claude")
```

Read Codex results.

```{R}
codex_results = read_xlsx("../ext/Record Reviews/three_literature_search_shared_for_codexGPT_classified.xlsx", skip=1)
names(codex_results)[16:19] = c("lehallierCite_codex",
                                "methodology_codex",
                                "ageTopic_codex",
                                "notes_codex")
```

Merge all evaluations. The first 15 columns have the same names in all files, so we don't need to specify a merge key. Use a full join in case of any issues.

```{R}
all_results = full_join(human_results, claude_results) %>%
  full_join(codex_results)
```

Convert the evaluation columns to integers for the purpose of visualization.

Citations:

```{R}
lehallierCols = grep("lehallierCite",names(all_results))
recodeCites = function(x)
{
  recode_values(x,
                "y"~1,
                "n"~0,
                "Yes"~1,
                "No"~0) # leave any other values as NA
}
all_results[,lehallierCols] = apply(all_results[,lehallierCols],2,recodeCites)
```

LOESS and/or DE-SWAN methodology:

```{R}
methodsCols = grep("methodology",names(all_results))
recodeMethodology = function(x)
{
  recode_values(x,
                "y"~1,
                "n"~0,
                "uncertain"~0.5,
                "unclear"~ 2,
                "Yes"~1,
                "No"~0,
                "Uncertain"~0.5) # leave any other values as NA
}
all_results[,methodsCols] = apply(all_results[,methodsCols],2,recodeMethodology)
```

Aging topic:

```{R}
ageCols = grep("ageTopic",names(all_results))
recodeAgeTopic = function(x)
{
  recode_values(x,
                "y"~1,
                "n"~0,
                "uncertain"~0.5,
                "unclear"~ 2,
                "Yes"~1,
                "No"~0,
                "Uncertain"~0.5) # leave any other values as NA
}
all_results[,ageCols] = apply(all_results[,ageCols],2,recodeAgeTopic)
```

Make a heatmap for exploratory purposes.

```{R}
# convert NAs to negative
tmp = all_results[,c(lehallierCols,methodsCols,ageCols)]
all_results[,c(lehallierCols,methodsCols,ageCols)][is.na(tmp)] = -1
heatmap.2(t(as.matrix(all_results[,c(lehallierCols,methodsCols,ageCols)])), trace="none",
          Rowv = F,col="bluered", margins = c(5,10)) 

```

What are the big hits?

```{R}
all_results %>% filter(lehallierCite_khs == 1,
                       lehallierCite_mc == 1,
                       lehallierCite_claude == 1,
                       lehallierCite_codex == 1,
                       methodology_khs == 1,
                       methodology_mc == 1,
                       methodology_claude == 1,
                       methodology_codex == 1,
                       ageTopic_khs == 1,
                       ageTopic_mc == 1,
                       ageTopic_claude == 1,
                       ageTopic_codex == 1) %>%
  View()
```

Human agreement:

```{R}
top_hits = all_results %>% filter(lehallierCite_khs == 1,
                       lehallierCite_mc == 1,
                       methodology_khs %in% c(1),
                       methodology_mc %in% c(1),
                       ageTopic_khs == 1,
                       ageTopic_mc == 1) 
```

Sources:

```{R}
table(top_hits$inString)
```

Year, by consensus of the most recent (in the case where preprints may have been earlier).

```{R}
top_hits$yearConsensus = pmax(pmax(top_hits$yearScholar,top_hits$yearSciDir,na.rm=T),top_hits$yearScopus,na.rm=T)
```

Manual patch for number 37:
```{R}
idx = which(top_hits$titleScholar == "Establishment and Application of a Cytokine Aging Clock in Chinese Population: A New Tool for Health Assessment")
top_hits$yearConsensus[idx] = 2025
```

Histogram: 

```{R}
top_hits %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=yearConsensus)) + geom_bar() + 
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count", 
    aes(label = after_stat(count)), 
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab("Number of Verified Search Query Results") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(2019,2026,by=1))
ggsave(file="literature_search_timeline_three_sources.jpeg",width=6,height=4)
```

How did we all do on methods?

```{R}
table(all_results$methodology_mc)
table(all_results$methodology_khs)
table(all_results$methodology_codex)
table(all_results$methodology_claude)
```

UpSet plot on citation (yes):

```{R}
cited = list("MC"=all_results[all_results$lehallierCite_mc == 1,]$Index,
             "KHS"=all_results[all_results$lehallierCite_khs == 1,]$Index,  
             "Codex"=all_results[all_results$lehallierCite_codex == 1,]$Index,
             "Claude"=all_results[all_results$lehallierCite_claude == 1,]$Index)
jpeg("lehallier_cite_upset.jpeg",width=5,height=5,units="in",res=300)
upset(UpSetR::fromList(cited), sets = rev(names(cited)), keep.order = T)
grid.text("Cites Lehallier et al. 2019", 0.6, 0.95)
dev.off()
```

UpSet plot on methods uncertainty:

```{R}
uncertain = list("MC"=all_results[all_results$methodology_mc == 0.5,]$Index,
             "KHS"=all_results[all_results$methodology_khs == 0.5,]$Index,  
             "Codex"=all_results[all_results$methodology_codex == 0.5,]$Index,
             "Claude"=all_results[all_results$methodology_claude == 0.5,]$Index)
jpeg("methods_uncertainty_upset.jpeg",width=5,height=5,units="in",res=300)
upset(UpSetR::fromList(uncertain), sets = rev(names(uncertain)), keep.order = T)
grid.text("LOESS/DE-SWAN Use Uncertain", 0.7, 0.95)
dev.off()
```

UpSet plot on aging:

```{R}
jpeg("topic_aging_upset.jpeg",width=5,height=5,units="in",res=300)
aging = list("MC"=all_results[all_results$ageTopic_mc == 1,]$Index,
             "KHS"=all_results[all_results$ageTopic_khs == 1,]$Index,  
             "Codex"=all_results[all_results$ageTopic_codex == 1,]$Index,
             "Claude"=all_results[all_results$ageTopic_claude == 1,]$Index)
upset(UpSetR::fromList(aging), sets = rev(names(aging)), keep.order=T)
grid.text("Main Topic Aging/Age-Related Disease", 0.65, 0.95)
dev.off()
```
